Kannada Film 'America America 2' Set for September 11 Release

Kannada filmmaker Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar is releasing 'America America 2', a spiritual sequel to his 1997 film 'America America'. The new movie is scheduled to premiere on September 11. Chandrashekhar, a veteran director, is discussing the upcoming film, which aims to recapture the magic of its predecessor released 29 years ago.
